summary: No mathematical errors or gaps found. Empty graphs, forests, two-edge cycles, singleton factors, arbitrary tilts, and unequal component degree scales do not refute the claim. The whole-union componentwise factorial estimate retains a single coefficient 1/64, and the component degree budgets are valid at and above 1024. The pointwise actual-halfspace product bound combines only the two nonempty groups, giving 1/4096. All predecessor hypotheses and explicit notation maps hold; reduction, intrinsic charting, and capacity normalization preserve the original probability table, boundary atoms, cycle rank, and total capacity T. The stated moment, root, and singleton conclusions follow exactly.
